title: membership.membership_activated event payload (v1)
description: docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md, section 19d.9/19d.16 (canon-0.6.0, PACK-07, ADR-030). Produced by epd2_membership_service.events.build_membership_activated_event - the distinct, final step following an approved MembershipApplication (ADR-030 item 2). Never carries region_code/organization_id on the wire (ADR-030 item 5). membership_status is always 'active' here - activate_membership is the only function that ever constructs this event.
